        Scan it with your phone's camera or the Krunk app. Only scan it with your own phone. Nothing is signed in until you check the code and approve it here.

        Or open this link on the phone:

        Someone scanned the code

        Approve only if this is your own phone or browser and you scanned the code just now. Approving lets it use your Krunk account. You can remove it at any time on this page.

        The code on your phone:

        Reset sync…

        Resetting deletes your encrypted sync data and the sync keys stored on the server: bookmarks, history, tabs, settings and passwords as synced. Your devices stay signed in and keep what they have locally. The next device that turns sync on sets it up again with a new passphrase.

        Use it if you lost your sync passphrase and recovery key, or want to start over. It can't be undone.

        Sync is turned on in Krunk, never here: the Krunk website never asks for your sync passphrase or recovery key.

          Your data

          Download everything your account holds on the server, as one JSON file.

          • Your account (email, dates, two-step on or off, how many backup codes are left), devices and signed-in browsers.
          • Activity with IP addresses, pending device links and QR codes, and the list of emails sent to you (type and time).
          • Your synced records, encrypted exactly as stored. No keys: only your devices can read them.

          The file is made for this browser only and downloaded here. It is never emailed.

          KruxSYS

          Krunk is a KruxSYS product: a fast, private browser for Windows, Android and Android TV. Open source (MIT), no telemetry.

          Bundles Chromium through the Chromium Embedded Framework, and filter lists by EasyList and uBlock Origin; see the notices in the download.
